parameterDescriptions.n: Moments of the canonical Maxwellian as tuples. The first entry defines the background (float for constant background or callable), the second entry defines a Perturbation (can be None).
parameterDescriptions.equil: Fluid equilibrium used to evaluate background profiles in the magnetic geometry.
parameterDescriptions.volume_form: If ``True``, represent the distribution as a volume form and include the appropriate velocity-space Jacobian when evaluating it.
parameterDescriptions.cache_size: Number of rows in the cache buffer for :math:`\psi_c` evaluation. If ``None``, no caching is used. Must be able to accomodate all markers on the current process.

summary: Base class for a distribution as a Dirac-delta in velocity (vth = 0).
descriptionHtml:
Base class for a distribution as a Dirac-delta in velocity (vth = 0).

The __call__ method returns the density evaluation.
